scope: Structural mechanics only: impact, drop, deformation, and elastic/plastic structural response. No fluid benchmarks.

requested_completion.algorithms: Attempt every applicable official structural example/model/strategy combination in the finite source inventory, recording genuine runtime or data blockers separately.
requested_completion.missing_truth: Generate and execute an identified OpenCourant structural case when required reference data are unavailable. A newly generated case is not relabeled as the original unavailable benchmark.
requested_completion.strain_definitions: Total strain, equivalent plastic strain, and kinematics-derived Green-Lagrange strain must be separate named quantities. A derived quantity is never described as an original solver-exported label.

truth_contract.shell_fields: Record local/global basis, integration location, tensor and engineering shear conventions, invariant calculation, and exact cell-to-node reduction. No averaging local tensor components across incompatible bases.
truth_contract.zero_fields: A present all-zero plastic-strain field is not evidence of learning plasticity. Record nonzero support and interpret according to material response.
truth_contract.projection: Retain the original solver field and the deterministic supervised projection contract. Report projection and numerical-rerun differences separately from model error.

learning_contract.split: Split independent simulations, not adjacent frames. Use the same split within a comparable example.
learning_contract.bumper_split: Existing train112/internal_validation12/evaluation7 split is retained where source identities agree.
learning_contract.normalization: Fit training-only statistics. Treat displacement xyz as one vector field: separate component means and one common scale sqrt((variance_x + variance_y + variance_z) / 3). Fit each other scalar field's own training standard deviation. Final comparable neural, RBF, and POD models use the same statistics and channel weights. Do not whiten a numerically zero displacement axis or reuse a 1 mm scale floor for stress/strain. Earlier displacement-only development baselines retain their own normalization and are not a final multi-field ranking.
learning_contract.selection: Use internal validation for checkpoints, POD rank, and regression hyperparameters. Evaluation labels are for reporting only.
learning_contract.coverage: Record geometry, material, boundary, contact, and loading coverage. Parameter interpolation is distinct from new-topology or product generalization.
learning_contract.compute: Determine experiment scale from measured memory/throughput and internal-validation learning curves. Initial coupon N=13 and phone N=9 are bounded starting datasets, not claims that those data counts suffice. A finite training cap alone does not prove convergence.
learning_contract.reuse: Reload a saved predictor in a fresh instance and check inference, geometry/node order, and serialization provenance.

per_field: displacement/field relative L2 with explicit denominator
vector or scalar P95 and maximum error
case peak and hotspot error where meaningful
nonfinite and physically invalid output counts
reporting_contract.zero_denominator: When reference field norm is zero, report absolute error and label relative error undefined rather than manufacturing a percentage.
reporting_contract.support: Direct rankings require identical evaluation cases, nodes/elements, times, field definitions, and units.
reporting_contract.timing: Separate FEM/data generation, preprocessing, training, warm forward, and complete inference. Record competing local workloads and sampled versus true peak memory.
reporting_contract.failure: Preserve the exact attempted configuration and concrete error. Do not count a shim or another algorithm under the requested model's name.

resource_contract.gpu_coordination: One worker owns GPU/framework-heavy execution at a time, assigned by root.
resource_contract.memory: Prefer streaming and memory-mapped caches. Preserve unrelated applications and the established working runtime.
resource_contract.cost: No additional paid resources, account purchases, or subscriptions without user agreement.

preservation: Record source/configuration, versions, commands, failures, logs, elapsed time, memory, checkpoints, and predictions. Public packaging excludes original datasets, third-party executables, credentials, and raw data-derived prediction archives where redistribution is unverified.
